name: Bar Harbor & Acadia NP
summary: Where the mountains meet the Atlantic — granite peaks, carriage roads, and the first sunrise in the country come fall.

lodging.name: Bar Harbor inn or Blackwoods Campground
lodging.blurb: Stay in walkable Bar Harbor for dinners, or camp at Blackwoods for a head start on the Cadillac sunrise.

foodMustTry.name: Popovers at Jordan Pond House
foodMustTry.blurb: Warm popovers with jam on the lawn, overlooking the pond and the Bubbles — an Acadia ritual.

days.label: Day 35 — Cadillac Sunrise & Park Loop
days.summary: Beat the sun to the summit, then drive the park's greatest hits.

item.title: Sunrise on Cadillac Mountain

location.name: Cadillac Mountain Summit
location.address: Cadillac Summit Rd, Bar Harbor, ME

item.blurb: From October to March, the first place in the U.S. to catch the sunrise. A timed vehicle reservation is required in season — book ahead.

item.title: Park Loop Road & Thunder Hole

location.name: Park Loop Road
location.address: Park Loop Rd, Bar Harbor, ME

item.blurb: The 27-mile scenic loop past Sand Beach, the crash of Thunder Hole, and the cliffs at Otter Point.

days.label: Day 36 — Carriage Roads & Jordan Pond
days.summary: Car-free roads, stone bridges, and popovers at the end.

item.title: Bike the carriage roads to Jordan Pond

location.name: Jordan Pond House
location.address: 2928 Park Loop Rd, Seal Harbor, ME

item.blurb: 45 miles of crushed-stone, car-free roads and hand-built stone bridges, ending with tea and popovers at Jordan Pond.

days.label: Day 37 — Free Day
days.summary: Rest, kayak, or just read on the rocks. Optional ideas below.

freeMenu.title: Bar Harbor whale watch
freeMenu.blurb: Finbacks and humpbacks offshore if the season and seas cooperate.

freeMenu.title: Browse Bar Harbor
freeMenu.blurb: Maine trinkets, taffy, and a lobster roll on the pier.

days.label: Day 38 — Drive to the White Mountains
days.summary: Trade the coast for New Hampshire's high country.

commute.scenicNote: A longer leg; the payoff is swapping the coast for alpine notches and peak foliage.
